layman_headline: Market fear is easing but no clear entry yet — staying patient for a better setup.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is still in 'Fear' mode at 30/100, though sentiment is slowly improving from extreme lows last week. Most altcoins are showing bearish chart structures with Bitcoin dominating capital flows at 56.5%. While a few coins like AAVE and ETH have bounced recently, the rallies lack volume confirmation and the risk/reward ratios on most setups are poor. This is a time to watch and wait rather than chase.
layman_action: No new trades recommended right now. Keep cash ready for a better entry if ETH pulls back toward $1,800-$1,850, which would offer much better risk/reward. Watch for sentiment to cross above 40 as a sign the market is stabilizing.
expert_reasoning: Applying validated Rule #9: ETH's chart analysis shows a risk/reward ratio of 0.34x, well below the 0.5x threshold that should trigger a downgrade to HOLD or cap confidence at 35%. The chart bias is slightly bearish (-0.40), price is below most MAs in a downtrend, and the nearest resistance at $1,900 is only 1.4% away while support at $1,800 is 4% below. The Fear & Greed index at 30 is improving (from 26 yesterday) but still in Fear territory. BTC dominance at 56.5% signals capital rotation away from alts, making alt entries higher risk. Among candidates, KAITO is overbought (RSI 83), DEXE crashed 90% in 7 days (catching falling knife), and AAVE/LDO already moved 10-13% this week. No candidate offers a compelling risk-adjusted entry.
risk_factors: BTC dominance at 56.5% continues to pressure altcoin performance — capital is flowing to BTC not alts
Fear & Greed at 30 could still deteriorate if negative catalysts emerge (BitMart shutdown, exploit news)
ETH chart structure remains in a downtrend with price below most moving averages — a lower low is possible
watch_list: ETH price action around $1,800 support — a test and hold there would create a much better entry with 2x+ R/R
Fear & Greed Index crossing above 40 — would signal meaningful sentiment recovery and safer alt entries
BTC dominance trend — a drop below 55% would signal capital rotation back into alts
market_context: The crypto market is in a Fear phase with sentiment at 30/100, improving from extreme fear last week. BTC is consolidating around $65K with 56.5% dominance, while alts show mixed signals — some bouncing but without volume confirmation or favorable risk/reward setups.
context_banner: Improving sentiment from extreme fear but risk/reward ratios across swing candidates remain structurally unfavorable — patience will be rewarded with better entries.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed at 30 improving from 26 yesterday and 28.6 weekly average — sentiment recovering but still in Fear zone, suggesting caution before new entries.
ETH RSI at 41 approaching oversold territory, but needs a pullback to $1,800-$1,850 support to create favorable R/R. Current 0.34x R/R violates the 0.5x minimum threshold.
All top candidates show bearish or neutral chart bias scores (-0.7 to -0.1). No candidate has a bullish chart structure with confirmed breakout.
Multiple negative headlines — Garden Finance exploit ($450K), Storj bankruptcy, WEMIX breach ($724K), BitMart shutdown — create headwind for risk appetite in altcoins.
ETH derivatives reset article suggests positioning is clearing out, which could set up a cleaner long entry on the next pullback but hasn't triggered yet.
